title: thread of care
intro: you can bring one word or a whole project. there is room for either. your answers stay in this tab until you save or share them yourself.
review: editorial translation · independent language review pending
seasonLabel: Freyja’s four hats · choose a texture
seasonPrompts: what would you like to bring into the warmth?
what would help you rest today?
what would you like to give a small first chance?
what would you like to share while you have the energy?
seasonNote: this is an authorial image from SUTI. you can change the season and keep your answers.
depths: a little closer · add a phrase
deeper · find a distinction and a step
threadsNote: the seven luminaries are an authorial story. the chakra names are images for the questions. choose one thread or try all seven, with an optional eighth. five element prompts follow.
stop: you can stop here. thank you for what you chose to share. choose one thread to take with you.
cleared: your map and answers have been cleared
empty: you can leave the map empty
flowText: like a sea breeze after a hot day. take a breath and ask yourself what you would like to let go of and what you would like to keep. one word is enough. you can simply stay here.
gameText: try one mask. the jester changes perspective, Finist tries again, the flamingo seeks company, Dragonis holds a boundary, and an Angel of Care asks permission. these are roles for today.
gamePrompt: the twelve gifts and seven luminaries are authorial images. try one request in the voice of two masks. which version leaves more room to choose?
formText: if you wish to share with the organizer, open the separate form and copy only the words you choose. the map sends nothing automatically.
contactText: if you wish, send me one phrase. I can listen and tell you what help I can offer. if this is about someone else, you can pass along the contact and let them decide whether to write.
closing: feet on the floor. a breath. a glass of water. go only as deep as feels right today.
